title: Wire C and Python into symbol_diff's language_for_path
description: symbol_diff.rs:language_for_path only maps \"rs\" and \"dart\" — C (.c/.h) and Python (.py) files return None and diff_file bails early with an empty Vec. This means diff_impact and commit_manifest never emit symbol-level changes (Added/Deleted/BodyChanged/CosmeticChanged) for C or Python files despite both parsers being fully wired.\n\nAdd the missing extension mappings: \"c\" | \"h\" → \"c\", \"py\" → \"python\". Verify with parser-backed diff tests for both languages.
root_cause: `language_for_path` only matched `\"rs\"` and `\"dart\"` extensions — C (.c/.h) and Python (.py) files returned None, causing `diff_file` to bail early with an empty Vec before parsing.
